/method/: The archive's method: the tiers, the ladder of five words, how living people are handled, and what this archive learnt reading FamilySearch indexes. The shared FamilySearch method is a skill; this page is the Lerena archive's own account.
/sources/: The sources consulted, graded by tier, with what each gave and where it is weak; the longer list of sources identified but not consulted; every collection searched with its link; what full text does and does not reach.
/searched/: The Search Register: every search made, what it returned and what it cost, per register with ark and image. The only complete record of what was looked at here.
/open-questions/: The open questions with what would settle each.
/errands/: The errands: what has been asked of other archives and the jobs that need a person in a building.
/worklist/: The work list: every open, running, blocked and done task, with the reasons for decisions.
/corrections/: Every claim published and taken back, what was said, what is true, and how it was caught; one of the pages of the linking standard.
/changes/: The working log of the archive, newest first, as it was written at the time.
/whats-new/: The pulse: what was read, found and corrected lately, by source, newest first (stays in Start as well).
/hypotheses/: Every proposition the archive entertains but has not proved, with what suggests it and what would settle it. A deep dive now.
/roadmap/: The ranked routes: finished, live, and those that need a person. Now in To do.
/family-papers/: The family's own papers, transcribed and shown (the 1971 and 1973 death notices are never shown). A deep dive now.
